name: OSPYR·6 REPORTING & ANALYTICS BRAIN — 26 sub-automations: per-client weekly reports + anomalies + monthly AI reviews

parameters.content:
# 📊 O6 · REPORTING & ANALYTICS BRAIN (26 sub-automations)
**COLLECT daily 07:45 (8):** ① Meta ads insights per client (spend/impr/clicks/leads) ② IG follower count ③ FB page fans ④ GA4 sessions (via GA4 Data API run-report) ⑤ manual-KPI rows (staff-entered) ⑥ append everything to Metrics tab ⑦ per-client cost-per-lead computed ⑧ ROAS if revenue present.
**ANOMALY WATCH daily 08:00 (6):** ⑨ spend spike >40% d/d ⑩ CPL spike >50% ⑪ zero-delivery detector (spend but no impressions) ⑫ follower drop ⑬ site traffic crash >50% ⑭ token-expired detection → all as instant 🔴 alerts.
**WEEKLY CLIENT REPORTS Mon 09:30 (7):** ⑮ AI writes a branded plain-language report PER CLIENT (numbers → meaning) ⑯ wins/concerns/next-week actions ⑰ WoW deltas ⑱ best creative call-out ⑲ copy-ready WhatsApp block per client ⑳ internal margin note (never sent to client) ㉑ report logged.
**MONTHLY 1st 09:00 (5):** ㉒ month-vs-month AI review per client ㉓ churn-risk score ㉔ upsell suggestion (from usage patterns) ㉕ portfolio overview for founder ㉖ case-study candidate detector (great results → O9).

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · TG_OSPYR_CHAT · OSPYR_SHEET_ID (tabs: Channels [tokens per client], Metrics[Date,Client,Source,Spend,Impr,Clicks,Leads,Followers,Sessions,Revenue]) · GA4: property IDs in Channels.GA4_ID + Google OAuth cred.
**FIX:** Meta insights 400 → act_ prefix on ad-account ID; GA4 403 → add the service account to the GA4 property; AI reports vague → more Metrics columns filled = sharper reports.
